summary: Syncloud is a self-hosted platform intended for managing personal online file storage, a social network, and an email server on your own hardware. It acts as an all-in-one system designed to help users host their own online services rather than relying on third-party cloud providers.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a consolidated platform to run multiple common web services on a single server without configuring each component separately.
watchOut: The lack of recent tagged releases and low maintenance score suggest potential stability risks and a lack of active community support.
deployNotes: Given the Go and Shell runtime stack, you will typically need to ensure persistent storage volumes are mounted for your data and configure a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
